products.name: Clinical Endpoint Logon & Profile Performance Optimization (FSLogix) — Commercial
products.short_description: Cut login times and stabilize sessions on shared clinical Windows endpoints (and AVD) with FSLogix profile containers + fast-logon tuning — sized profile storage, sensible exclusions, bloat control, and sign-in optimizations, measured before and after. Self-guided, tested.
products.description:
Tap on and be working in seconds — fast, stable clinical logons

On shared clinical endpoints, slow logons and unstable roaming profiles cost clinicians minutes at every device — and minutes add up across a shift. This solution applies the standard fix: FSLogix profile containers on sized, correctly-permissioned profile storage (SMB/Azure Files), sensible redirections/exclusions and bloat control, and fast-logon tuning — all measured with a before/after baseline (logon seconds, profile load) and designed to play nicely with Imprivata tap-and-go fast user switching. Works for shared clinical workstations, WOWs, and AVD session hosts.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the FSLogix + fast-logon model and the measure→tune→measure approach.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (FSLogix entitlement, an SMB/Azure Files profile share + permissions, Intune or GPO management, Win10/11 or AVD hosts, the FSLogix agent, a baseline measurement, test users) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing, plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Guide — ordered, full-path steps: deploy the FSLogix agent, configure Profile Container to the named share, set redirections/exclusions, tune fast logon, pilot, measure, expand. Every object named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — FSLogix config/share discovery, per-device validation (configured + container attaches + logon-time sample), logon-time/profile-size report, safe stale-profile remediation, and a logon-baseline capturer.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates (logon reduced vs baseline, stable sessions), plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Shared clinical endpoints that log on in seconds with stable, roaming profiles — measurably faster than before and friendly to tap-and-go — across workstations, WOWs, and AVD.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CLINLOGON-Discovery.ps1 — Clinical Endpoint Logon & Profile Optimization (FSLogix) - inventory / discovery (read-only)
    • CLINLOGON-Remediation.ps1 — Clinical Endpoint Logon & Profile Optimization (FSLogix) - safe fixes
    • CLINLOGON-Report.ps1 — Clinical Endpoint Logon & Profile Optimization (FSLogix) - logon-time + profile-size
    • CLINLOGON-Set-FSLogixBaseline.ps1 — Clinical Endpoint Logon & Profile Optimization (FSLogix) - capture the logon
    • CLINLOGON-Validation.ps1 — Clinical Endpoint Logon & Profile Optimization (FSLogix) - per-device validation

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
